limitations: Growth classes are judged on t <= 9 only and may change for larger t; 'linear' and 'geometric' are empirical labels except for the fuse magma (Theorem 4).
novelty_basis: Same searches as CLM-C15-04; the magma-automaton framework itself is Pedersen's (1992) and Moore's, but no census of this kind was found. Low confidence.
statement: Of the 1734 order-3 magma automata (up to isomorphism and mirror image), on t <= 9 the streaming width is bounded for 808 classes, grows linearly for 104, geometrically for 300 (largest lambda(9) = 649) and irregularly for 522; 43 are surjective, 7 injective and 34 nilpotent by t = 9.
title: Census of order-3 magma automata by streaming width
